mcp-server.title: Best Open-Source MCP Servers ({year}) — Security-Graded
mcp-server.heading: MCP Servers, Security-Graded Before You Connect
mcp-server.intro: An MCP server hands an AI agent real capabilities — and often real credentials. Every server here is scored on 10 signals and, once its README has been read, graded Safe, Caution, Unsafe or Reject (Unaudited until then), so you know what you're wiring into your agent before you connect it.

claude-skill.title: Best Claude Skills ({year}) — Open-Source, Quality-Scored
claude-skill.heading: Claude Skills That Are Safe to Drop Into Claude Code
claude-skill.intro: A Claude Skill runs with your agent's full permissions, so trust matters as much as usefulness. These are the top open-source Claude Skills, each quality-scored on documentation and structure, and security-graded once its README has been read, so you can check it before you add it to Claude Code or Cursor.

codex-skill.heading: OpenClaw & Codex Ecosystem Skills, Trust-Checked
codex-skill.intro: Tools built for the OpenClaw and Codex agent runtimes, indexed from GitHub and refreshed every 8 hours. Each is quality-scored, and security-graded once its README has been read, so you can extend your coding agent without importing a black box.

agent-tool.title: Best AI Agent Tools ({year}) — Open-Source, Security-Graded
agent-tool.heading: AI Agent Tools, Ranked by Signal Not Hype
agent-tool.intro: Standalone tools that give agents new abilities — automation, retrieval, orchestration, and more. Ranked by a 10-signal composite (not raw stars) and security-graded, so the top of the list is what's actually worth installing.
